title: Storage
search_index_desc: Stored on this device only, encrypted. Clearing it keeps your messages; the index rebuilds on the next search
thumbnail_cache_desc: Local cache for chat image and video covers
emoji_cache_desc: Local cache for chat emoji stickers
other_data_desc: Contains credentials and encryption keys. Cleared on logout, not here
unavailable: This environment does not support local storage statistics
server_quota_partial_desc: This homeserver does not expose quota statistics
server_quota_exceeded: Media quota exhausted, uploads will be rejected
auto_cache_desc: When off, chat image/video thumbnails are no longer written to disk and load from the remote URL instead
clear_hint: Only the search index is cleared. Messages, media and login state are kept
clear_cache_hint: {files} cached files. Media reloads on demand after clearing
clear_cache_confirm_message: This deletes {files} cached files ({kind}) on this device. Messages and login state are unaffected; they reload when needed.
nothing_to_clear: Nothing to clear in the search index
clear_confirm_message: This clears the local search index ({events} messages, {rooms} rooms). Messages, media and login state are unaffected; the index rebuilds on the next search.
